description: On a scheduled morning-briefing run, questioned whether to proceed and asked David for confirmation before doing the work, instead of treating the current working folder (/Users/davidohara/develop/jarvis) as the correct, complete project root and just running the workflow.
correction: The current working folder is always the correct project root and has everything needed. On scheduled/autonomous runs, do not stop to ask for scope confirmation over path or data-handling concerns that are already covered by standing instructions — verify paths directly (e.g. list the directory) instead of assuming a mismatch, and proceed.
systemic_fix: Before flagging a path/scope concern as blocking, check the actual filesystem first (ls/glob) rather than reasoning from a path string in the task file. Default to executing scheduled tasks in the current folder without a clarifying question unless a real, unresolvable blocker is found after checking.
